hook: A massive machine just carved the first tunnel beneath the Panama Canal.

sections.voiceover: A massive machine just carved the first tunnel beneath the Panama Canal.
sections.visual_cue: Aerial shot of the Panama Canal waterway.
b_roll: Aerial view of the Panama Canal

text_overlay.text: First tunnel under the Panama Canal

sections.voiceover: On 26 October 2026, the 13.46m diameter Herrenknecht Mixshield TBM named Panamá finished its 4.5km drive. Why did Metro de Panamá steer this massive tunnel-boring machine beneath the Panama Canal?
sections.visual_cue: Close-up of a TBM cutterhead in a workshop environment.
b_roll: Stock footage of a Herrenknecht TBM cutterhead
Map animation highlighting Farfán to Albrook route

sections.voiceover: The Albrook breakthrough marked the first bored tunnel ever built under the Panama Canal.
sections.visual_cue: Cross-section diagram of the tunnel under the canal floor.
b_roll: Technical schematic of the tunnel profile

sections.voiceover: Project director César Pinzón confirmed the team finished the 4.5km subterranean drive on 26 October 2026.
sections.visual_cue: Project team on-site at the Albrook breakthrough point.
b_roll: César Pinzón at the breakthrough site

sections.voiceover: The Panamá TBM completed its 4.5km journey under the canal.
sections.visual_cue: Wide shot of the TBM emerging at the Albrook site.
